name: Emerge Technologies
summary: Kalgoorlie ISP/IT firm, formed 1999 by the merger of Ludin Computers (also trading as Goldfields-Esperance Internet) and GoldNet; spun the ISP side back to GoldNet ~2013 (EMERGE TECHNOLOGIES PTY LTD, ACN 087 855 221).

events.details: Founded July 1999 from the merger of Ludin Computers (trading as Goldfields-Esperance Internet) and Goldnet Internet Services.

ISP side of the business spun back to GoldNet; Emerge continued as carrier-grade network services firm. Retail internet-account sales disappeared from the homepage between Feb and Aug 2007; the MSP business on emerge.net.au (and GoldNet on the network side) does not extend the ISP.

refs.label: retail ISP homepage (new accounts/pricing/dialup numbers), 5 Feb 2007
by 29 Aug 2007: IT consultancy + carrier/minesite services, webmail-only login — no retail ISP sales
still an IT/MSP business in 2021 — non-ISP survival does not extend ISP death; network/ISP side lives on as GoldNet (sister operator)
ABR: EMERGE TECHNOLOGIES PTY LTD ACN 087 855 221
